clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge guides young dwarven paladins in the Hall of Mysteries. She teaches that the Light calls for virtue, charity, and self-sacrifice, and tests initiates before they may wield its gift of resurrection.

Tiza Battleforge guides paladins in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. Across the Alliance, tutors send initiates to her for deeper spiritual study. Brandur Ironhammer sends them from Ironforge, Azar Stronghammer from Dun Morogh, and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker from Stormwind. Tiza teaches that the Holy Light asks more than martial skill. Its servants must offer humble service, show compassion, and stand firm against the Scourge and other threats.
